rule: Raw table ('PS' already converted to NaN)
Remove exact duplicate rows / duplicated UNITID
Remove rows without a target (missing or privacy-suppressed earnings)
Remove institutions that are no longer operating
Keep predominantly certificate / associate / bachelor institutions
Remove rows whose earnings are based on fewer than 30 former students
De-duplicate branch campuses: one row per OPEID6 (main campus preferred)
Negative locale code -> NaN
UGDS = 0 -> NaN
INEXPFTE <= 0 -> NaN
TUITFTE <= 0 -> NaN
TUITIONFEE_IN <= 0 -> NaN
MD_FAMINC <= 0 -> NaN
Admission rate = 0 -> NaN
4-year completion rate = 0 -> NaN
Less-than-4-year completion rate = 0 -> NaN
Race/ethnicity shares do not sum to 1 -> NaN
Men + women shares do not sum to 1 -> NaN
Programme shares do not sum to 1 -> NaN
HIGHDEG < PREDDEG -> HIGHDEG = PREDDEG
